item.title: Mortgage Payment options code review
item.description:
Hey guys, in my free time I'm creating a tool to populate the ideal payment schedule based on a fixed rate mortgage.
My code can be found [here](https://github.com/pmcinelly784/Pub/blob/main/Mortgage%20Payments/House%20Payment%20Tool.qmd) and I'd appreciate some input, specifically on whether or not my formula for BiWeekly payments is accurate, because it seems like it isnt. Thanks!
